rows: **FFF→MMM = genealogical grouping.** It is a birth-order feature. It does not partition polarity. Each member may contain both tendencies.
**Yin-first = traversal convention.** Direction of reading. Not a claim of exclusivity.

**4→5 = curved interpenetration.** Earth and aether share the fourth quarter with a curved interface; each contains a seed of the other. Total area 1/4 preserved; the split is not a straight cut at 1/8+1/8 in sequence.
